name: codegraph
description: Graph a function's whole call flow into FigJam — syntax-highlighted snapshots of every function it calls, recursively, wired call-site to definition.

codegraph.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory where CodeGraph writes snapshot PNGs. Absolute paths are used as-is; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. When empty, defaults to `.codegraph` in the workspace root.

codegraph.serverPort.markdownDescription: Port for the local server that hosts `graph.json` and snapshot PNGs for the FigJam plugin to fetch. Bound to `127.0.0.1` only.

codegraph.includePaths.markdownDescription: Restrict the graph to function definitions living under these directories/modules. When non-empty, a definition is graphed only if it lives under one of these (the selected entry function is always graphed). Entries may be workspace-relative directories (`src/services`), absolute paths, tsconfig `paths` aliases (`@shared`, `@shared/*`, `@/services`), or workspace-package names. `node_modules` is always excluded regardless. When empty, everything not in `#codegraph.excludePaths#` is included.

codegraph.excludePaths.markdownDescription: Skip function definitions living under these directories/modules (no box, no connector; recursion stops there). Takes precedence over `#codegraph.includePaths#`. Entries may be workspace-relative directories (`src/legacy`), absolute paths, tsconfig `paths` aliases (`@vendor`, `@vendor/*`), or workspace-package names.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
